## What changed

Describe the user outcome and the evidence used to verify it.

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck, lint, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Documentation and security/privacy boundaries are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, personal configuration, customer data, or generated secrets are included.

## Community extension submissions

- [ ] The directory name equals the manifest slug and `npm run validate:extensions` passes.
- [ ] Source repository, immutable commit, license, required metrics, and permissions are documented.
- [ ] The publisher did not add or claim an independent review of their own submission.
